about: First Peter is a letter of hope to Christians who were having a hard time.

pages.title: Give God Your Worries
pages.scene: A child handing a basket of worries to God
pages.text: Peter wrote, "Give all your worries to God, because He cares for you." Peter knew this well. Jesus had held his hand when he sank in the water! God is strong, and He takes care of us.
